main.description: Delete the signed-in user's BookHive PDS records, local data and uploaded files, then sign out. Does not delete their Bluesky account or posts. Requires a live OAuth session, not service auth. Cross-system deletion can partially succeed; failures are reported, never confirmed as success.

confirmHandle.description: Exact current handle (DID fallback if no profile is available). No trimming or case folding. No additional input fields are accepted.

errors.name: DeleteFailed
errors.description: Cleanup failed and may have partially succeeded. The session is kept so the user can retry.
